title: 选择的代价：完备、可组合与可传递的三维权衡——复杂知识系统如何形成、演化与更新 / The Price of Choice: The Impossibility Triangle of Completeness, Composability, and Transfer
description:
中文. 本著作提出“选择的代价”诊断框架，用以解释任何有限复杂度知识系统在形成、演化与更新中的结构性困境。

核心主张：完备（C）、可组合（A）、跨尺度传递（T）至多同时充分具备两项；选择两项，第三项必然留下可定位的缺口。信息子模性、离散—连续断层（1/3 缺口）与时间错配 τ 是三条理论见证。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—Y、38 幅图；医疗、教育、组织、金融（LTCM 1998）、软件工程、人工智能六个领域被放进同一张价目表，并配十个反例与逐条反驳条件。

诚实的纪律：全部主张按 A/B/C 与甲/乙/丙双重分级；37 个开放问题（O1—O37）标明已证、假设与待验证；失败与曾被推翻的强主张写在正文与附录，而非藏在脚注。

边界：框架给出“失效的形态与方向”的诊断，不给出新配置的预测，也不替代领域判断；它的用途是让设计者在选择两项时，看见第三项会怎样失效。

版本：2026-10-18，279 页，25 章，38 图，附录 A—Y，O1—O37；源码与脚本开源，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

本版更新（2026-10-18 地基版）。本版把全书的共同前提写到卷首：现实中不存在无限——无限只作为极限出现在模型里，从不出现在现实系统的实际状态里。有限性本身只说明“有上界”；它要变成“必须让出一样”，还需要三个条件同时成立：需求随规模增长、描述/组合/传递共享同一承载者、同时维持两种活动更贵（交互惩罚 ψ>0）。因此“至多取二”一律是“紧预算（K/D 有界）下至多取二”的简写；若预算增长快于需求，三项可以同时满格。

本版新增内容。新增 §2.2b 与命题 2.0：有限性是必要前提，Q（三活动构成性且共享承载者）∧ R（ψ>0）才是三角的实质；§2.7 命题 2.1 改为尺度相对形式；新增 §22.4b“第四性质的四道门”（构成性、可独立测量、非冗余、独立代价），审查成本、可计算性、可扩展性、鲁棒性、普遍性；第 5—10 章诊断块加入“紧约束”，第 11、13、16 章加入有限性诊断；O7/P9 的反例条件统一为“紧预算下同时满格”。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/impossibility-triangle。首选预览文件：impossibility-triangle-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work presents “The Price of Choice,” a diagnostic framework for the structural dilemma of any finite-complexity knowledge system. Core thesis: completeness (C), composability (A) and cross-scale transfer (T) can be fully held at most two at a time; choosing two leaves an identifiable gap at the third. Information submodularity, the discrete–continuous gap (1/3) and temporal mismatch τ serve as theoretical witnesses. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–Y, 38 figures; six domains — medicine, education, organisations, finance (LTCM 1998), software engineering and AI — are mapped onto one price list, with ten counterexamples and refutation conditions. Discipline: every claim carries an evidence grade (A/B/C) and a conceptual grade; 37 open questions (O1–O37) mark what is proved, assumed or untested, and failures are reported in the main text. Boundaries: the framework diagnoses failure modalities and directions, not novel configurations, and does not replace domain expertise. Edition: 2026-10-18, 279 pages, 25 chapters, 38 figures, appendices A–Y.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-18, Finitude Edition). The common premise is now stated at the front: there is no infinity in reality — infinity appears only as a limit in models, never as a property of a real system. Finitude alone only says that there is a ceiling; to yield a trade-off it also needs three conditions: demand grows with scale, description/composition/transfer share one bearer, and maintaining two activities at once is more expensive (interaction penalty ψ>0). “At most two” is therefore shorthand for “at most two under a tight budget (bounded K/D)”; if the budget grows faster than demand, all three can be full.

New in this edition. New §2.2b and Proposition 2.0: finitude is necessary, while Q (constitutive triad sharing one bearer) ∧ R (ψ>0) is the substance of the triangle; §2.7 restates the proposition in scale-relative form; new §22.4b gives four gates for a fourth property (constitutive, independently measurable, non-redundant, independent cost) and reviews cost, computability, scalability, robustness and universality; chapters 5–10 add a “tight constraint” line, chapters 11, 13 and 16 add finitude diagnoses; O7/P9 counterexample conditions now require a tight budget.
notes: 科目（中文）：复杂系统 Complex Systems、系统科学 Systems Science、知识论 Epistemology、信息论 Information Theory、科学哲学 Philosophy of Science、制度设计 Institutional Design、管理学 Management。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：25 章，约 268 页。首选预览文件：impossibility-triangle-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
